P2G (Polish 2 Glow) is a skincare brand focused on refined, effective routines. Our products are designed to support smooth, radiant-looking skin with a clean, elegant presentation.

Polish 2 Glow skin lightening and polishing milk lotion is an advance formulated body milk that enriches your skin and gives you a well toned look. it is developed with the greatest care to restore damaged skin as it tones and polishes the skin from a dull to a more brighter and fairer look.
